name: ClickBench host · q29
description: Replaces each URL with its host, as ClickBench query 29 does to group page views by referring domain.

name: URL host
description: Extracts the host of each URL, skipping a leading www and any port.

name: Query parameter names
description: Extracts the name of every parameter in each URL's query string.

name: Key-value values
description: Extracts the value of every key=value pair in each log line.

name: Quoted field
description: Extracts the contents of the first double-quoted field in each value.

name: TPC-H part type · q2
description: Matches part types that end in BRASS, as TPC-H query 2 selects parts.

name: TPC-H part name · q9
description: Matches part names that contain green, as TPC-H query 9 selects parts.

name: TPC-H order comment · q13
description: Matches order comments that contain special and, later, requests, which TPC-H query 13 excludes.

name: TPC-H part type · q14
description: Matches part types that start with PROMO, as TPC-H query 14 measures promotion revenue.
